Title: Azure Active Directory B2C in Australia is available in public preview

Body.Content:
Starting April 9, 2021, Azure Active Directory B2C is available in preview in Australia. In addition to the capabilities of the global Azure AD B2C service, customers can keep their user data within Australia and provide faster performance by being closer to customers and their organization's location.

Learn more.
